title: EXAMPLE — how a release announcement is written
note: Ships DISABLED on purpose: it is a template to duplicate, not a message for the fleet. To announce a real feature — duplicate this, write it, point its anchor at the new control, enable it, raise rev, commit, push. Studios that already saw the previous rev see it again.

steps.title: What changed in this release
steps.body:
One paragraph, in the app's own voice: what it does, what it replaces, and where it lives.

Announcements point at the control they are about — a release note nobody can act on is a changelog entry in the wrong place.
